Though the offences under sections 307 and 326 of the IPC are non-compoundable, having regard to
the fact that the incident in the present case did not have an impact on the society in general, and
having regard to the fact that the dispute between the parties has been settled amicably and there is
no likelihood of the repetition of such incident, we allow the application for
compromise/compounding of offence and set aside the orders of conviction and sentence passed by
the courts below against the appellant by exercising our jurisdiction under Article 142 of the
Constitution of India. The appellant is ordered to be acquitted of the charges levelled against him. Similarly, in those cases where the conviction is already recorded by the trial
